gloss: refined white sugar; superior white sugar

definitions.gloss: refined white sugar; superior white sugar
definitions.explanation: The most common type of granulated white sugar used in Japan, finer and slightly more moist than Western granulated sugar.

examples.japanese: {上白糖|じょうはくとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大|おお}さじ→大さじ：22527_oosaji⟧{二杯|にはい}⟦{加|くわ}える→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧。
examples.english: Add two tablespoons of refined white sugar.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家庭|かてい}→家庭：12315_katei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{上白糖|じょうはくとう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{最|もっと}も→最も：01736_mottomo⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{使|つか}われる→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{砂糖|さとう}→砂糖：00884_satou⟧だ。
examples.english: In Japanese households, refined white sugar is the most commonly used sugar.

examples.japanese: {上白糖|じょうはくとう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦グラニュー{糖|とう}→グラニュー糖：23996_guranyuutou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{比|くら}べて→比べる：01237_kuraberu⟧⟦{粒|つぶ}→粒：03892_tsubu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{細|こま}かく→細かい：01245_komakai⟧、⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{溶|と}け→溶ける：02302_tokeru⟧やすい⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{特徴|とくちょう}→特徴：03456_tokuchou⟧だ。
examples.english: Compared to granulated sugar, refined white sugar has finer grains and dissolves more easily in cooking.

notes:
Literally "superior white sugar," from ⟦{上|じょう}→〜上：30365_jou⟧ (superior), {白|はく} (white), and {糖|とう} (sugar). This is the default sugar in Japan — when Japanese recipes simply call for ⟦{砂糖|さとう}→砂糖：00884_satou⟧ (sugar), they typically mean {上白糖|じょうはくとう}.

Unlike the coarser granulated sugar (⟦グラニュー{糖|とう}→グラニュー糖：23996_guranyuutou⟧) common in Western countries, {上白糖|じょうはくとう} has a finer texture and contains a small amount of inverted sugar, giving it a slightly moist quality and milder sweetness. It accounts for roughly half of all sugar consumption in Japan.

- {上白糖|じょうはくとう}⟦{大|おお}さじ→大さじ：22527_oosaji⟧⟦{一杯|いっぱい}→一杯：01793_ippai⟧: one tablespoon of white sugar
- {上白糖|じょうはくとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{加|くわ}える→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧: to add white sugar
- {上白糖|じょうはくとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{代|か}わり→代わり：01296_kawari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: instead of white sugar

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦グラニュー{糖|とう}→グラニュー糖：23996_guranyuutou⟧: granulated sugar — coarser crystals, commonly used in Western baking
